test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 7 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Roopa walked from her office 20 metres towards the north, 50 metres towards the east, 25 metres towards the north, and then 50 metres towards the west. She stopped at this point to visit a friend at her house. She again walked 30 metres towards the east. How far and in which direction is Roopa's office from her friend's house?
solution: Given: • Roopa walked from her office 20 metres towards the north, • 50 metres towards the east, 25 metres towards the north, • and then 50 metres towards the west. • She stopped at this point to visit a friend at her house. • She again walked 30 metres towards the east.
